source: gamedbRC.slt List_BadgeAndTitleUnlocks (377 rows); exe SQL "SELECT ... FROM List_BadgeAndTitleUnlocks WHERE UnlockId=%d" with fallback UnlockId=1; xtsw SetPlayerCardInfo {currentCareerLevel u32, currentBadgeId u16, currentPlayerTitleId u16}
idSpace: badgeId and playerTitleId are List_BadgeAndTitleUnlocks.UnlockId (one shared id space; a row may be a badge, a title or both)
rule: Hardcore: accept badgeId only if in badgeIds, playerTitleId only if in titleIds. Ownership (unlocked by the player) is a separate check: UnlockCategory/UnlockLevel give the condition, which needs the profile (driver level, achievements).
zero: 0 is not a table id; the game itself falls back to UnlockId 1 for an absent row. Treat 0 as "none" only if real clients send it (verify in play data).
